math: Zero is neither positive nor negative.
The angles in any plane triangle add up to 180 degrees.
Pi is irrational: its decimal expansion never ends and never repeats.
The square of any real number is non-negative.
date: A common year has 365 days, while a leap year has 366.
In the Gregorian calendar, most leap years occur every four years.
year: A decade is a period of ten years.
A century is a period of one hundred years.
The Gregorian calendar has no year zero.
The year 2000 was a leap year.
trivia: A banana is botanically classified as a berry.
Giraffes have seven neck vertebrae, the same number as humans.
Honey can remain edible for a very long time when stored properly.
